test_title: PYST 53: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As in July 2021, The NIPUN Bharat Scheme was launched by which of the following Ministries?

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Education**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The NIPUN Bharat Scheme was launched by the Ministry of Education in July 2021.
 
• NIPUN stands for National Initiative for Proficiency in Reading with Understanding and Numeracy.
 
• The aim of the NIPUN Bharat Scheme is to ensure that every child in India attains foundational literacy and numeracy by the end of Grade 3, by 2026-27.
 
• The scheme is an essential part of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 which focuses on early education and foundational learning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**

 
 
• The NEP 2020 is a comprehensive framework to guide the development of education in the country.
 
 
• **Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN)**
 
 
• FLN refers to the basic reading, writing, and arithmetic skills that form the foundation of a child's education.
 
• The NIPUN Bharat scheme specifically targets the attainment of FLN by children at the primary level.
 
• FLN is crucial for the overall cognitive development of a child and impacts their ability to learn more complex subjects in higher grades.
 
 
 
• **Implementation of NIPUN Bharat**
 
 
• The scheme is implemented by the Department of School Education and Literacy under the Ministry of Education.
 
• It involves the training of teachers, the development of age-appropriate learning materials, and regular assessments to track progress.
 
• The initiative promotes a participatory approach involving parents, community members, and local bodies to ensure the effective implementation of the scheme.
